name: Venly Arauna
bio: Venly Arauna Dondokambey is an Indonesian actor, singer, and internet personality. He originally gained widespread popularity as a content creator on TikTok before successfully transitioning into mainstream Indonesian television and film.

credits.title: Dominion of Darkness: Rephaim
credits.overview: Following a catastrophic, failed ritual in a remote Indonesian province, two Catholic exorcists are deployed to confront a devastatingly powerful ancient entity unleashed by an ancestral pact for illicit wealth.

credits.title: Tuhan, Benarkah Kau Mendengarku?
credits.overview: After a devastating divorce leaves her to raise her child alone, a resilient single mother faces the ultimate test of forgiveness when she is forced to care for her ailing ex-husband and his new wife under her own roof.
